sn9.10:1.2: The verb _saṅkasāyati_ is a synonym of _allīyati_, to stick or adhere to ([pli-tv-kd3:1.2.3]()).
sn9.10:2.1: At [an4.191:1.7](), _dhammapada_ refers to all nine categories of the teaching, and I think it has the same sense here.
sn9.10:3.1: The sense of this unusual five-line verse is not entirely clear to me, and I suspect it is corrupt.
